# Need dictionary

*Model V0-24. Generated by `build_calculations_workbook.py` from the same data as the Dictionary tab and [Dictionary.md](Dictionary.md). Edit the data in the build script, not this file.*

Naming: need `N_xxx`, risk `R_xxx`, parameters `XXX_WHAT`. The code (src/, frontend/) still uses the eight V0-14 needs and the old parameter names until it follows the model.

## Overview

| Code | Need | Category | Risk | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `N_INC` | Income & family protection | Protection · calculator | `R_DEA` | Live |
| `N_CRI` | Critical illness | Protection · calculator | `R_CRI` | Live |
| `N_TPD` | Total & permanent disability (TPD) | Protection · calculator | `R_TPD` | Live |
| `N_HOS` | Hospitalisation | Protection · calculator | `R_HOS` | Live. Open: one code (N_HOS) in GP and HU |
| `N_PAC` | Personal accident | Protection · calculator | `R_PAC` | Agreed V0-18 (Excel). Code and HappiU payload to follow |
| `N_ADB` | Accidental death | Protection · candidate | `R_ADB` | Added V0-17 to the dictionary. No calculator, not scored |
| `N_LTC` | Long-term care | Protection · calculator | `R_LTC` | New V0-19. Off unless the customer switches it on |
| `N_RET` | Private retirement | Wealth · calculator | `R_LON` | Live. R_LON stress: need re-sized to LON_AGE 99 |
| `N_EDU` | Child's university education | Wealth · calculator | — | Live |
| `N_SAV` | Savings goal | Wealth · calculator | — | Live. No longer swapped with N_PRP |

| `N_HOM` | Home protection | Coverage · parked | — | Scored and prioritised only |

## N_INC · Income & family protection

Money the family needs if the earner dies: debts are cleared and today's spending continues for the support years.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Protection · calculator |
| Risk / trigger | R_DEA |
| Parameter prefix | INC |
| Calculator | bequest + mortgage + PV of annual spend over support years |
| Parameters | INC_SUPPORT_MIN 10, INC_SUPPORT_MAX 25, INC_SUPPORT_PIVOT_AGE 50; slider bequest, dependYears. Have = life sum assured. |
| App label | Income & family protection |
| Need Profiler label (key) | Life Protection (life_protection) |
| HappiU | N_INC |
| Scenario Visualizer | premium |
| Status | Live |

## N_LTC · Long-term care

Nursing-home cost from the care start age until life expectancy, in today's money.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | Protection · calculator |
| Risk / trigger | R_LTC |
| Parameter prefix | LTC |
| Calculator | annuity-due of LTC_COST over care years (LTC start age → life expectancy) |
| Parameters | LTC_COST USD 129,000 a year (× price level); LTC_START_AGE 80 (front-end input); care years = lifeExpectancy − start age. Stress R_LON: care until 99. Have = 0 (no existing LTC cover or social scheme yet). |
| App label | Long-term care |
| Need Profiler label (key) | none (no profiler label) |
| HappiU | not sent (HU engine has no LTC) |
| Scenario Visualizer | premium |
| Status | New V0-19. Off unless the customer switches it on |

## N_RET · Private retirement

The lump needed at retirement to pay today's spending × lifestyle for the years in retirement. CPF is not counted.

|---|---|

| Risk / trigger | R_LON |
| Parameter prefix | RET |
| Calculator | annual spend × lifestyle, grown to retirement, × annuity over years in retirement |
| Parameters | RET_LIFESTYLE_FRUGAL 75%, RET_LIFESTYLE_STRESSFREE 100%, RET_LIFESTYLE_ONLYTHEBEST 125%; ageOfRetirement 65; lifeExpectancy (cap 99). Stress R_LON: LON_AGE 99. |
| App label | Private retirement |
| Need Profiler label (key) | Retirement (retirement) |
| HappiU | N_RET |
| Scenario Visualizer | RET pot |
| Status | Live. R_LON stress: need re-sized to LON_AGE 99 |
